source.name: data.geofencing_zones.features[].properties.rules[].ride_allowed

schema_definition.description: Is the undocked ride allowed to start and end in this zone?

definition_lines.text:
\- `ride_allowed` | Conditionally REQUIRED | Boolean | REQUIRED if `rules` array is defined. Is the undocked (“free floating”) ride allowed to start and end in this zone?

`true` - Undocked (“free floating”) ride can start and end in this zone.
`false` - Undocked (“free floating”) ride cannot start or end in this zone.

Both definitions are arrays of vehicle type IDs to which this polygon rule applies; v3.0 pluralizes the original key.

v2.3 ride_allowed jointly governs starting and ending undocked rides. v3.0 has independent ride_start_allowed and ride_end_allowed. Neither one alone represents the original joint predicate, so this is not a one-to-one equivalent match or a pair of interchangeable targets.

The zone-local rule is absent from the target projection. The same leaf name under global_rules governs default restrictions outside an explicitly overriding zone, not this polygon. The v3.0 Rule Precedence prose distinguishes the scopes.

projection.source: All scalar leaves of the v2.3 geofencing endpoint; arrays mechanically traversed.
projection.target: All scalar leaves of v3.0 geofencing endpoint except polygon-local ride_through_allowed and station_parking. Their global-rule counterparts are retained as explicit scope distractors. Only the first complete endpoint example is sampled; later polygon-overlap fragments are not mixed into feed records.

limitations: Publisher-authored illustrative examples, not observed service boundaries.
The v3.0 example omits some schema-defined global rule values; these produce empty samples.
One source predicate splits into two independent target predicates. It is labeled no_match under the one-to-one equivalence standard, not ambiguous.
Coordinates are mechanically flattened numeric leaves, not invented longitude/latitude columns.
Mapping a localized name requires selecting the intended locale; the matcher case evaluates the name concept only.
label_standard: Match means same operational concept, allowing ordinary representation conversion. A combined predicate split into independent predicates has no single equivalent target. Arrays are flattened mechanically. Different scope or operational state is not equivalent.
